name: demo-triage
description: Demo read-only investigation of the "my claim was submitted twice" intake ticket, launched by a Builder: declares a short plan, inspects the claim submission path with Glob, Grep and Read only, closes its plan with test evidence and summarises the root cause and a fix in text without touching a file. It files no diagnosis on the ticket: only the triage agents intake itself launches can (report_diagnosis refuses other sessions).

tasks.title: Trace the claim submission and retry path
Confirm the root cause against the submission tests

steps.thinking: Every retry posts the claim again without an idempotency key: a slow first attempt that eventually succeeds leaves a duplicate.

evidence.detail: The existing test never retries a slow submission: the gap that let this through

steps.text: Findings (read-only, confidence 0.84): submitClaim() retries a slow first attempt without an idempotency key, so a success after the app gave up files a second claim. Fix: send an idempotency key with every submission and return the first claim for a repeated key, with a regression test that retries a slow submission. No file was changed.
